tasks.label: check: current file
tasks.detail: ruff + mypy on the open file (.py or .ipynb)
tasks.command: F=$(echo '${file}' | cut -d'#' -f1); echo "checking $F"; echo; echo '─── ruff ───'; uv run ruff check --output-format=concise "$F" && echo '✅ ruff ok'; echo; echo '─── mypy ───'; { case "$F" in *.ipynb) uv run nbqa mypy "$F";; *) uv run mypy "$F";; esac; } && echo '✅ mypy ok'; echo
